No Definition text changed and no new prerequisite is needed.

The Definition calls this the nondifferentiable L1 merit function for rho>0 and explicitly disclaims positivity, acceptance and convergence. It asserts no local or global exactness theorem and no equivalence of minimizers for arbitrary rho. The witness f(x)=-x, h(x)=x, 0<rho<1 correctly disproves such an additional theorem, but contradicts none of the displayed definitions. D_rho is exactly the negative linear objective-plus-penalty model change, with the g<=0 positive-part convention. The title names the standard exact-penalty family, not an unconditional exactness assertion; the item is unchanged.

The supplier defines row order but does not assert independence. Corrected F1 to attribute independence to the explicit full-row-rank hypothesis A1. The kernel proof already uses precisely the Statement hypotheses: Az=0 and z^THz=0 force z=0, then injectivity of A^T forces mu=0. The r=0 case reduces to positive definite H, and a zero-dimensional matrix has trivial kernel. This was a nonfatal citation-description defect, with unchanged Statement and proof.

The SOC supplier returns displacement d=p+w, not correction w. The caller previously tested x+p+d, adding p twice. For h(z)=z-1, f(z)=z^2/2, x=0, B=1, rho=2 and sigma=1/4, p=1 and w=0; intended merit at 1 is 1/2<=3/2, whereas the literal old candidate 2 has merit 4. The current computed-QR theorem no longer assumes the distinct conditional-QR premise named in the rejection. Its actual supplier thm-scaled-householder-qr-backward-stability proves QR and stored-reflector-vector bounds directly from the local kappa_r lemma by norm induction and orthogonal transport. The KKT procedure calls exactly those real active-column steps and separate-vector updates; full rank, Nu<1 and gamma_(N+3)<1/8 meet the current theorem hypotheses. Successful back substitution supplies nonzero pivots and the triangular perturbation. With square orthogonal Q, Delta_K=Delta_Q+Q Delta_R gives the second residual bound; the rounded-residual lemma gives the first for the same exactly admitted K,b. Their minimum is valid; no perturbed-system uniqueness assumption is needed. The old conditional-premise objection does not apply to the current supplier chain, and this item is unchanged.
